bare_dir.description: Where the bare clones live: `.` for the workspace root, a relative path, an absolute one, or `~`.

base_branch.description: What new branches fork from. `None` means the bare clone's own HEAD.

integrations.description: Tools `ws` drives around a workspace; each resolves `auto` against whether its program is on PATH.

logs.description: Where the output of `ws run` is kept.

mux.description: The terminal multiplexer session a switch opens.

name.description: Workspace name, used in session names. Defaults to the directory `ws.yaml` is in.

repo_layout.description: `auto`: one repository makes the branch directory the worktree, several group them under it. `single` and `grouped` force one or the other.

repos.description: The repositories of the workspace, one entry each. Belongs in the workspace `ws.yaml`, not the global config.

tasks.description: Where `ws run` finds tasks, and how it shows them.

worktree_dir.description:
Base directory the branch directories are created in. Relative to the
workspace root, or absolute; `~` is expanded.

ByteSize.description: A size in bytes, or text like `10MB`, `512K`, `1GiB`. The units are binary. `0` never rotates.

oneOf.description: When the output is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is not set.

command.description: Launcher command, one word per element.

layout.description: `tabs`: one tab per repository. `panes`: all of them side by side in one tab.

session.description: Named herdr session; only passed when running from outside herdr.

HerdrLayout.description:
How the repositories of a branch are laid out inside the herdr workspace —
the counterpart of `[mux.tmux] layout`.

Integrations.description:
The tools `ws` drives around a workspace, each under its own key.

Every one of them resolves `enabled: auto` against whether its program is
actually on `PATH`, so a workspace picks up what the machine has without
being told, and `enabled: false` opts out.

local.description: Untracked files kept beside the workspace and placed into every worktree.

npm.description: npm: `npm ci` by default; seeding is opt-in.

pnpm.description: pnpm: install held to the lockfile, seeded from another worktree.

uv.description: uv: `uv sync`; a virtualenv is never seeded.

yarn.description: yarn: install held to the lockfile, seeded from another worktree.

zoxide.description: Register worktrees and branch directories with zoxide.

LocalConfig.description:
Untracked files kept beside the workspace — `.env`, editor settings, a
personal `Makefile.local` — and placed into every worktree.

dir.description:
Where the files are kept, resolved like `bare_dir`. With several repos
it holds one subdirectory per repo, named after it.

paths.description:
Rules matched in order against each entry's path relative to the
repo's local directory; the first one that matches decides how it is
placed, and an entry no rule matches is left out.

oneOf.description:
A symlink to the file in the local directory: one file, shared by
every worktree, edited in one place.

A hard link: shared like `link`, but a real file to tools that refuse
to follow a symlink. An editor that saves by renaming breaks it.

mode.description: How a matching file is placed: `link`, `copy` or `hardlink`.

pattern.description:
Regular expression the whole relative path has to match, with `/`
between its components.

LogsConfig.description: Where the output of `ws run` is kept, beyond the terminal.

dir.description:
`{branch_dir}` stands for the branch directory the tasks run in;
otherwise resolved like `bare_dir`.

enabled.description: Write the output of `ws run` to log files as well.

file.description:
The file inside `dir`, with `{branch}`, `{repo}` and `{task}` in it.
Tasks whose files coincide share one, each line marked with its task.

keep.description: Rotated files kept beside the live one, `<file>.1` the most recent.

max_size.description:
A file is rotated once it would grow past this: `10MB`, `512K`, or a
number of bytes. `0` never rotates.

timestamps.description: Start every line with the local time it was written.

backend.description: `auto` picks the multiplexer that is running or installed.

on_none.description: What to do with no multiplexer: `print-path` prints the branch directory, `nothing` stays silent.

root_window.description: Name of the shared window/pane; empty disables it.

PackageManagerConfig.description:
One package manager's settings. Every key is optional and falls back to
what [`Manager`] says, so `yarn: { enabled: false }` is a complete entry.

command.description: Launcher; defaults to the manager's own name.

enabled.description: `auto` means: whenever the program is on PATH and a repository is recognisably its.

install.description:
Arguments that install the dependencies. Left out, each manager gets
the ones that hold it to its lockfile — see
[`crate::integration::pm::default_install_args`], which resolves them
against the worktree because yarn's depend on its version.

link.description:
Seed a new worktree's dependency directory from an existing one.
Ignored by a manager that cannot be seeded that way.

enabled.description: `auto` means: whenever a repository has a `package.json`.

name.description: Name of the repository. Defaults to the last segment of the URL without `.git`.

path.description:
Where this repo sits inside a branch directory; defaults to its name.
May be nested, e.g. `services/api`.

setup.description: Command or commands run in the worktree once per new worktree, after the install. A string or a list; placeholders such as `{branch}` and `{env:NAME}` are replaced.

oneOf.description: One repo -> the branch directory itself is the worktree; more -> grouped.
The branch directory is always the single repo's worktree.
The branch directory always holds one subdirectory per repo.

TaskSource.description: A file a repository declares its tasks in.

oneOf.description:
The `scripts` of `package.json`, run with the repository's own
package manager.

TaskToolConfig.description: `just` or `task`: on when the program is on `PATH`, unless told otherwise.

command.description: Launcher; defaults to the tool's own name.

enabled.description: `auto` means: whenever the program is on PATH.

TasksConfig.description: Where `ws run` finds a repository's tasks, and how it shows them.

color.description:
Colour the prefixes — and let the tasks colour their own output,
which they stop doing once it goes through a pipe.

order.description:
The sources a task name is looked up in, in order: the first one a
repository has the task in runs it. A source left out is not read.

command.description: Launcher command, one word per element.

layout.description: `windows`: one window per repository. `panes`: all of them in one window.

picker.description: How the branch picker opens: `popup` (tmux popup), `inline`, `none`, or `auto`.

picker_cmd.description: Picker command, one word per element.

command.description: Launcher command, one word per element.

enabled.description: `auto` means: whenever zoxide is on PATH.

register.description: Which directories to register with zoxide.
